jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is a voluntary/advisory position seeking those with substantial expertise and lived experience in the field, which the candidate lacks. Although the human-rights and securitisation subject matter is genuinely interesting, the position is neither a genuine paid vacancy for the candidate nor at their level.
